title: law.go.kr evidence of absence: the delegated administrative rules (위임행정규칙) linked to Act Art 32 and Decree Art 24, and a title search of current administrative rules for 인공지능
status_note: Evidence, not law. Three responses from law.go.kr, read 2026-10-24. (1) and (2): the popup law.go.kr opens for the delegation phrase in Act Art 32(3) ('고시하여야 한다', joNo 0032) and in Decree Art 24(2) (joNo 0024); the page marks both links 'NOT' (class delegatedAdmRul_link_not) and the popup reads: '훈령·예규·고시 등의 행정규칙이 제정되지 아니하였거나 내부공문 및 업무지침 등의 형식으로 운용 중입니다. 자세한 사항은 이 법령의 제명 우측 하단에 기재된 소관부서로 문의하여 주시기 바랍니다.' (3): the administrative-rules search (admRulScListR.do) for rule titles containing 인공지능, current and scheduled rules (p6=2,3), which listed 27 rules and no notice on AI safety or on the results Art 32(2) requires; it does list 과학기술정보통신부고시 제2026-50호 '인공지능 제품ㆍ서비스 확인 절차 운영에 관한 고시' (2026-07-21), which was not read and whose basis was not checked. The same search for '인공지능 안전성' and for '인공지능 발전과 신뢰' returned 0 rules (not deposited). Absence from law.go.kr is evidence, not proof: the popup itself allows that rules may be operated as internal documents or guidelines.
